newsitem.title: HONG KONG: North Jianshe '96 net hits 117 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: North Jianshe '96 net hits 117 mln yuan.

text.p: Shenzhen North Jianshe Motorcycle Co Ltd recorded net profits of 117.18 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in an announcement after the market closed on Monday.
Earnings per share were 0.25 yuan in 1996 and turnover reached 2.49 billion yuan, the exchange said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards, and gave no comparative figures.
The company posted net profits of 288.71 million yuan on total turnover of 3.61 billion yuan in 1995 under international accounting standards.
The firm's board of directors have proposed a cash dividend of 0.069 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, the exchange said.
Trading in the company's B shares will be suspended on Tuesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, it said.
